+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: Report the usage of each generation call in a turn
+---
+## Problem
+
+A turn that uses tools makes many generation calls inside one `backend.respond` or `backend.streamResponseFragments` call. Router stamps usage one time for each turn. A reader cannot tell a model that reasoned too long from a context that filled up. Evidence: django__django-13964, 2026-09-21: 41 rounds, one usage stamp (tokensIn 1,955,561, tokensOut 53,634).
+
+## What we know
+
+- `MLXFoundationModelsSessionBackend.streamResponseFragments` (`Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Resolution/LiveModelLoader.swift:298`) sees each snapshot in `observe`. `snapshot.usage` is the usage of the generation call that made the snapshot, and `snapshot.transcriptEntries` shows the entries of that call. `recordLastGenerationCall` keeps only the last one.
+- Router wraps every mounted tool (`Hosting/ToolRun.swift`), so each tool call open and close is already visible to the session.
+
+## Do this
+
+1. When the last entry ID of a snapshot changes, or when a tool call opens, emit one per-call record: fed tokens, generated tokens, finish reason (ceiling or natural end), entry kind (text, tool call), and the measured context after the call.
+2. Send it as a `SessionEvent` and write it to the run journal, so a recorded transcript shows each call.
+3. Do not change any compaction policy in this task.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- A test with a fake backend that makes three generation calls in one turn gets three per-call records with correct counts.
+- The turn-level usage stamp stays the same.
+
+Requested by foundationmodelsacpagent-08. This task can land before the other tasks of this set. #compaction
\ No newline at end of file

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m34hs2vy5trym2z6h66m9ydp
+  text: |-
+    ### research
+
+    - `finishTurn` in `Session/RoutedSessionActorRecording.swift` reads `backend.usageTokenCounts()` one time at the end of an attempt. The delta from `usageBefore` is the turn-level stamp. It goes on the last `.response` partial and on `SessionEvent.turnEnded`.
+    - The session sees each tool call open. `ToolRun.open()` posts the open `ToolInvocationRecord` to the outbox. The outbox calls `RoutedSessionActor.deliver(invocation:)` before the tool body runs. The tool wrapper is the same for every mounted tool.
+    - The stream gives no snapshot for a generation call that sends no text (see `lastGenerationCallOutputTokenCount`). A tool-open is the one signal that such a call ended.
+    - `TranscriptEvent.Kind` has router-only kinds (`session`, `embedding`, `divergence`). `isEntryKind` is false for them. Exhaustive switches over the kind: `TranscriptEvent.isEntryKind`, `TranscriptEntryMapper.entry(from:)`, `SessionProjection` (2 sites), `RoutedSessionActorRecording.emitSessionEvents`.
+    - Exhaustive switches over `SessionEvent`: `SessionProjection.apply`, `TurnOutcomeFold.apply`, `Examples/MultiModelGeneration/main.swift`.
+    - Test fixtures: `LiveBackendContainer` runs the real `MLXFoundationModelsSessionBackend` over a test `LanguageModel`. `CeilingProbeLanguageModel` shows how an executor sends `.updateUsage` per call. `MarkerEmittingTool` is a mountable tool with `AmbientToolArguments(value:)`. `InMemoryRecorder` holds the journal.
+
+    ### plan
+
+    1. Add `GenerationCallUsage` (tokensIn, tokensOut, finishReason, entryKind, contextFill) and `GenerationCallEntryKind` (text, toolCall) in `Session/SessionEvent.swift`. Add `SessionEvent.generationCall(_:)`.
+    2. Add `TranscriptEvent.Kind.generationCall`, a router-only kind. The journal line holds the counts in `tokensIn`/`tokensOut` and a summary in `text`.
+    3. Keep a per-attempt ledger on the actor: the usage at the start of the attempt, the ceiling, and the calls recorded so far. At a tool-call open of the own turn, and at the end of the attempt, the delta between the cumulative usage and the ledger is the usage of the call that ended. A zero delta is no call.
+    4. Emit the record live through the turn sink and write it to the journal, before the open `toolInvocation` event and before the turn's diff.
+    5. Test with a metered tool-loop model that sends explicit usage per call: three calls in one turn give three records with the scripted counts, and the turn stamp is the sum.
